implementerProof.how: At 417d96141003ba5bad7dc6fd5f45aa983975c61f: `printf` of the nine variables in this container resolves each under /legion (scratch, go, uv), none to /legion/harness; `df -h /legion $HOME /tmp` puts /legion on the 49G volume and $HOME and /tmp on the container's `/`; the old phrase 'through one of the variables the runtime actually sets' is gone from tools.md; `diff -r skills/legion-worker packages/claude-envoy/legion/skills/legion-worker` is empty. The implementer's claim — the reworded condition admits the worked case at /legion/harness — holds. The failure below is what else the rewording admits.

failures.criterion: The test's first condition admits the page's worked case without sanctioning a placement the page's own cited learning forbids (review round 9's finding, fixed without opening a new hole).
failures.evidence: skills/legion-worker/references/tools.md:84-88 now reads: lands on the issue's own volume, under `/legion` ... 'or under a path on that volume your harness names itself'. `$LEGION_WORKSPACE` is such a path — /legion/workspaces/sjawhar/legion/infra-221, on the same 49G volume (`ls /legion`: feed go repos scratch sessions workspaces) — and the INFRA-43 learning the worked case cites says 'Put nothing under `$LEGION_WORKSPACE`: six roles share that jj workspace'. Driven in this role container: `mkdir -p .harness-probe/usr/bin`, a 2-line `pg_ctl` and an `env.sh` written under the workspace, then `jj status` -> `A .harness-probe/env.sh`, `A .harness-probe/usr/bin/pg_ctl` in the shared working-copy commit (`snapshot.auto-track` is `all()`; `snapshot.max-new-file-size` is 1MiB, so every small file of an extraction root is snapshotted); removed, `jj status` clean and @ empty again. So a role that follows the condition as written can put its harness root where jj tracks it into every role's working copy, and the condition calls that sanctioned; at b4ebc2dd the nine-variable wording excluded it, since none of the nine is under /legion/workspaces. The same widening admits /legion/sessions (Oh My Pi's session store) and /legion/repos. Fix (one clause in the one statement): 'on the issue's volume, outside `$LEGION_WORKSPACE` — whose untracked files jj snapshots into every role's working copy — and outside the runtime's own directories', keeping the repository's own dependency set (`uv sync`/`bun install` into its ignored directories) as the page already sanctions it. No red test: a test asserting a skill's wording is a source-text test, which this repository's rules forbid.
